classification.reason: Source explicitly reports integration of fitted bands and ratio;not a model inferred by this project. Per-cell acquisition provenance remains separate unknown.

reported_scalar.precision: Preserve literal source precision;reject nonfinite/negative;no0–1or0–100 cap.
reported_scalar.unit_boundary: Dedicated ratio role,not percent,concentration,peak-height ratio or DSC reference crystallinity.

derivation_required.formula: source explicitly reports integrated numerator-area divided by denominator-area;ordered roles fixed,no reciprocal substitution

numerator_band.role: fitted integrated carbonyl-band area;not peak maximum height

denominator_band.role: fitted integrated carbonyl-band area;actual integral value/positivity unknown unless source states it

derivation_required.source_model: Source-reported lineshape must be stated;first version limited to Gaussian carbonyl-area ratio,not arbitrary peak models.
derivation_required.unknown_rules: Unknown facts status explicit,textnull,primary method/condition evidence and notes;never use curator absence statement as reported fact. Partial facts must separate reported portion from unknown details.
derivation_required.input_boundary: Source ratio and declared method sufficient;raw areas need not be invented. Do not execute fitting/integration/division,invert or derive missing areas. Source-author reported denominator coordinate is not a known positive area.

uncertainty: Only explicit source typed absolute ratio amplitude or source relativeCV,never infer SD/CI/n from duplicate or fitR2. Unknown uncertainty retained. Negative absolute amplitude rejected,no upper cap;keep confidence/coverage unknown unless reported.
identity_and_dedup: Existing identity only;method context not independent sample. Same state,quantity,primary document and original result cell: changing/relabeling ordered band coordinates,correcting order,filling unknowns,definition/statistical interpretation updates are revisions,never coexisting secondfacts. Normalize scalar spellings,ignore annotations;substantive coordinates do not override sourcecell identity. Truly distinct source result cells or protocols can remain distinct only with primary source evidence. Preserve original locator semantics;arbitrary locator rewording cannot create newcell.
presentation: Existing four languages en/zh/ja/de must fully display ordered band roles,known facts,unknown states and source-only notice. Explain fitted integrated ratio,not concentration or phase percentage. No new language scope. Human views exclude implementation constants;full metadata survives JSONL/export/recovery/copy isolation.
compatibility: Append closed dedicated branch;preserve all28 old branches/definitions/enums/runtime role behavior. Do not treat dedicated wavenumber metadata as generic measured result or engine input.
